# Brief: register claude-monitor as a non-dispatchable agent-runtime identity

## Context
`scripts/agent_runtime/registry.py` (`AGENTS` dict) has per-epic Claude identity
rows for existing epics, e.g. `claude-infra` (mirrors `claude` adapter/model,
`cli_available: False`, `resume_policy: "never"`) — used only so SessionStart's
dispatch-lane self-test (`scripts/agent_runtime/lane_probe.py` via
`.claude/hooks/session-setup.sh`) can resolve the per-epic agent identity
without treating it as a real spawnable CLI lane. The `monitor` epic (#7177,
created 2026-08-23) has no such row, so every monitor-epic SessionStart logs:
`DISPATCH LANE SELF-TEST FAILED for claude-monitor: agent is not registered`.

## Task
1. In `scripts/agent_runtime/registry.py`, add a `"claude-monitor"` entry to
   `AGENTS`, placed alongside the other `claude-*` identity rows (after
   `claude-infra`). Mirror `claude-infra` exactly except capabilities — reuse
   the same `adapter`, `default_model`, `cost_tier`, `cli_available: False`,
   `resume_policy: "never"`. For `capabilities`, reuse `claude-infra`'s
   frozenset (`architecture`, `review`, `planning`) unless you find an existing
   more specific precedent for a track-epic identity row — if so, follow that
   precedent instead and note it in the PR description.
2. Confirm the self-test now reports `skipped` (not "not registered") for this
   agent:
   `.venv/bin/python -m scripts.agent_runtime.lane_probe --agent claude-monitor --cwd $(pwd) --timeout 2`
3. Grep the repo for any other place that enumerates `AGENTS` keys by hand
   (tests, docs, schema) and update if it would otherwise go stale — do not
   assume the dict is the only place; search literal `claude-infra` for
   sibling references per the rename/refactor checklist (this is an addition,
   not a rename, but check whether tests assert the full key set, e.g.
   `test_agent_registry*.py`).
4. Run `.venv/bin/ruff check scripts/agent_runtime/registry.py` and the
   targeted pytest for this module/registry tests.

## Out of scope
No other registry rows, no adapter changes, no session-setup.sh changes.
